title: 第3章 放开我就扒你裤子第4章 越嚣张奖励越多
slug: 大师姐摆烂后带五个道侣飞升了
content_zh:
江欲听到系统的话顿时有些咋舌，她实在是没想到面前的这个人居然这么可怜。
天天被当成工具人用就算了，居然连人家身上的器官都不放过。
依她看这个宗门不用叫什么太虚剑宗了，干脆叫太虚园区吧。
毕竟里面压榨人的手段一个比一个更加过分。
沧溟开口嘲讽江欲的时候就已经想到了自己的结果，要么就是被丢到剑宗的火池里受折磨，要么就是面前的人直接翻脸，把自己的魔骨抽掉。
但是他这么多年已经受够了！！
这次就算是死他也要骂爽了死个痛快！！
这么想着，沧溟一副视死如归的表情抬头，却对上了江欲有些同情的目光。
还没等沧溟弄明白江欲为什么是这个表情的时候，江欲说话了。
“你说是她们抽走了你的魔力？”
沧溟不知道为什么江欲要重复自己的话，但还是点头：“不然呢，我都已经说过了你的这个小师妹不是什么好人。”
“这个人生来就喜欢抢走别人的东西。”
“你总是不相信我们……”
江欲抬头看着面前的人，有些感慨虽然少年看起来脾气不好，但是好像是一个实实在在的话痨，一说起来就停不下来了。
她开口打断了沧溟的话：“那我们就都去拿回来。”
沧溟撇嘴，一脸都是又来了。
又想要骗我去送死。
但是江欲可没有和他掰扯的意思，有些事情要真的做了才能说服别人，光在这里打嘴炮就算是说一万年沧溟都不会相信她的。
江欲说着转身回到房间抓出了自己的剑，出门朝着愣在原地的沧溟歪了歪头。
“走吧，去给你证明一下我是不是在骗你。”

看着沧溟站在原地一脸不相信的样子，江欲故意说道：“还是你就是害怕了，不敢过去。”
这话顿时让沧溟有些不服气，他堂堂魔族少主怎么可能会有害怕的一天。
反正横竖都是死，他也抬脚跟上了江欲的步伐。
这个世界有四个大陆，每个大陆都有不同的类型的修真者。
江欲所在的是第二大的青云大陆，这里的修真者大多都是剑修，而她所在的宗门，则是最有实力的剑修宗门之一。
太虚剑宗。
既然是最有实力的宗门，占地面积也是非常大，就连江欲这个没什么地位的提款机大师姐都能有一座属于自己的山门。
但是太大也有点不好，别人根本不知道原主在这里每天都在经受非人的折磨。
原身为了不被电击，每天就沉浸在找法宝，找法宝，找法宝的路上，有时间的时候想要修炼却发现自己怎么都没法有进步。
再加上原主平常压力太大，每天都在疯狂地暴饮暴食，原本匀称的身材已经变得有些肥了。
所以江欲尝试了几次都没有成功的飞起来。
而沧溟虽然能够变成魔体飞过去，却站在一边一动不动，没有想要带着江欲的意思。
这让江欲有些不爽，我的道侣不带我难道还要带别人吗？
她伸手直接拉住面前的人，用命令的语气开口道：“带我过去。”
“你想的美。”
content_en:
Jiang Yu was stunned when she heard the system's words. She really didn't expect that the person in front of her was so pitiful.
Even if he is used as a tool every day, he even spares the organs on his body.
In her opinion, this sect doesn't need to be called Taixu Sword Sect, let's just call it Taixu Park.
After all, the methods used to exploit people are more extreme than the last.
When Cangming opened his mouth to taunt Jiang Yu, he had already thought of his own outcome. Either he would be thrown into the sword sect's fire pool and tortured, or the person in front of him would turn against him and have his demon bones removed.
But he has had enough after all these years! !
Even if he dies this time, he will scold him and die happily! !
With this thought in mind, Cang Ming looked up with a look of death, but met Jiang Yu's somewhat sympathetic gaze.
Before Cangming could figure out why Jiang Yu had this expression, Jiang Yu spoke.
"You said they took away your magic power?"
Cangming didn't know why Jiang Yu wanted to repeat what he said, but he still nodded: "Otherwise, I have already told you that this junior sister of yours is not a good person."
"This man is born to take other people's things."
"You always don't believe us..."
Jiang Yu raised his head and looked at the person in front of him, feeling a little emotional that although the boy seemed to have a bad temper, he seemed to be a real talker and couldn't stop talking once he started talking.
She interrupted Cang Ming and said, "Then let's all go get it back."
Cangming pouted, with a look on his face that he had done it again.
You want to trick me into dying again.
But Jiang Yu had no intention of breaking up with him. Some things had to be really done to convince others. Cangming wouldn't believe her even if she just talked here for 10,000 years.
Jiang Yu said as he turned back to the room and grabbed his sword. He went out and tilted his head towards Cangming who was stunned.
"Let's go and prove to you whether I'm lying to you."
Seeing Cangming standing there with a look of disbelief, Jiang Yu deliberately said: "Or you are just afraid and don't dare to go there."
These words immediately made Cangming a little unconvinced. How could he, the young master of the demon clan, be afraid of such a day.
Anyway, he was going to die, so he raised his feet and followed Jiang Yu's pace.
There are four continents in this world, and each continent has different types of cultivators.
Jiang Yu is located in the second largest Qingyun Continent. Most of the cultivators here are sword cultivators, and the sect she belongs to is one of the most powerful sword cultivating sects.
Taixu Sword Sect.
Since it is the most powerful sect, it also covers a very large area. Even Jiang Yu, a cash machine elder sister with no status, can have a mountain gate of her own.
But it's also a bit bad if it's too big. Others don't know that the original owner is undergoing inhuman torture every day here.
In order to avoid being shocked, the original person was immersed in looking for magic weapons, looking for magic weapons, and looking for magic weapons every day. When he had time, he wanted to practice but found that he could not make any progress.
Coupled with the fact that the original owner was usually under too much pressure and overeated crazily every day, his originally well-proportioned figure had become a little fat.
So Jiang Yu tried to fly several times without success.
Although Cangming could transform into a demon body and fly over, he stood motionless and had no intention of taking Jiang Yu with him.
This made Jiang Yu a little unhappy. If my Taoist companion doesn't take me, why should I take someone else with me?
She stretched out her hand to grab the person in front of her and said in a commanding tone: "Take me over."
"You think beautiful."
